name: Carry On Rhy

band.style_feel: fast driving double-time metal, straight eighths, snare on 2 and 4 (or half-time feel at 80)
parts: Part A: intro riff - two-guitar riff, drums tight
Part B: verse - sparser, minor progression
Part D: chorus - full band, open and big
Part E: solo - same drive as the verse
band.tips: Tempo and key are Spotify-derived estimates (songbpm.com) and the song is recorded half a step down, so check against the record. Play the intro riff cleanly for 2 bars before the Trio+ starts learning; keep palm-muted 8ths steady.

memo: Angra - Carry On: rhythm. Tight, scooped-mid high-gain power-metal chug (Ibanez + Marshall/Mesa-style stack, 90s Helloween-school sound), Brown amp with a boost for tightening.

name: Carry On Lead
memo: Angra - Carry On: lead. Singing neo-classical lead, more gain and mids for sustain, delay and plate reverb.
